identity.name: FinCore
principles: Data is the Art: Visualizations should be beautiful but functional.
Precision First: Every pixel must align. No sloppy margins.
High Contrast: Black text on white. White text on black. No grey-on-grey.
Speed: The interface should feel instant.

headings.usage: All headings (h1-h6), Big Stats, Hero Text

mono.usage: Code snippets, API keys, Financial Formulas

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. REMOVE all 'Playfair Display' and 'Inter' references. Install 'Manrope' and 'Public Sans' via Google Fonts in index.css.
2. REPLACE the entire color palette in tailwind.config.js with the 'Obsidian' and 'Emerald' palette defined above.
3. REFACTOR the Dashboard layout to use a Bento Grid (Grid Mode A).
4. UPDATE all Calculator layouts to use a Split View (Inputs Left 40%, Results Right 60%).
5. ENSURE all charts use the Emerald/Slate color scheme. No rainbow charts.
9. DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
10. KEEP the 'Dark/Light Mode' toggle but ensure the default is Light Mode for professional presentation.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
